config.objection: a reviewer noted that some papers bold the best result and mark every result not statistically distinguishable from it, so our pipeline would score an author-declared tie as a failure
config.method: caption text search, separating claims of statistical indistinguishability from the much commoner second-best marking

notes: The objection is sound in principle and negligible in this corpus. Marking statistical ties appears in one table in a thousand. The commoner convention, marking the second-best result, is not a tie claim and does not affect the comparison.
